label: dex_files
sql: SELECT file_id, source_path FROM dex_files ORDER BY file_id

label: classes
sql: SELECT file_id, descriptor, superclass_descriptor FROM classes WHERE descriptor IN ('Lorg/telegram/messenger/MessagesStorage;','Lorg/telegram/messenger/MessagesController;','Lorg/telegram/messenger/NotificationCenter;','Lorg/telegram/messenger/MessageObject;','Lorg/telegram/tgnet/TLRPC$Message;','Lorg/telegram/ui/Cells/ChatMessageCell;','Lorg/telegram/ui/ChatActivity;') ORDER BY file_id, descriptor

label: methods
sql: SELECT file_id, method_idx, descriptor, param_descriptors, return_descriptor FROM methods WHERE method_kind IS NOT NULL AND name IN ('markMessagesAsDeletedInternal','deleteMessages','markDialogMessageAsDeleted','postNotificationName','removeDeletedMessagesFromNotifications','measureTime','setMessageObject','createView') AND class_descriptor LIKE 'Lorg/telegram/%' ORDER BY class_descriptor, name, descriptor

label: fields
sql: SELECT DISTINCT class_descriptor, name, type_descriptor FROM fields WHERE name IN ('currentTimeString','timeTextWidth','timeWidth','messageOwner','edit_date','flags','messagesDeleted','currentAccount','currentMessageObject') AND class_descriptor IN ('Lorg/telegram/ui/Cells/ChatMessageCell;','Lorg/telegram/messenger/MessageObject;','Lorg/telegram/tgnet/TLRPC$Message;','Lorg/telegram/messenger/NotificationCenter;','Lorg/telegram/messenger/MessagesStorage;') ORDER BY class_descriptor, name

label: deletion_names
sql: SELECT file_id, method_idx, descriptor FROM methods WHERE method_kind IS NOT NULL AND class_descriptor = 'Lorg/telegram/messenger/MessagesStorage;' AND (name LIKE '%Deleted%' OR name LIKE '%Deleted%' OR name LIKE '%delete%' OR name LIKE '%updateDialogs%') ORDER BY name, descriptor
